contentText:
Are these actually new, or just fresh color variants of the Moto Tag 2? | Image: Evan Blass

Motorola's unannounced Moto Tag 3 has been listed for sale online, just five months after the Moto Tag 2 went on sale in the US, and before any official announcement of a follow-up. The listing on Amazon UK was spotted by X user @matteventu , and shows the tracker in a "Pantone Lucent White" color option, with a price of £24.96 (about $33) and a 1-4 month shipping estimate.

A second image shared by leaker Evan Blass also shows a vibrant purple version of the new tracking tag, which is described as "Pantone Indigo Blue" on a separate Amazon Italy listing . Both are new color options, with the Moto Tag 2 only currently available in orange or a …

Read the full story at The Verge.
